metaTitle: Amennuɣ n Iɛeskriyen Uqeṛḍasen (241–237 send Ɛisa) — amenɣi « ur yettwasemmeḥ ara »
metaDesc: Amennuɣ n Iɛeskriyen Uqeṛḍasen, neɣ amenɣi « ur yettwasemmeḥ ara » (Polybe I, 65–88) : lexlaṣ ur yettwaxelṣen ara, Spendios, Mathos akked Autarite, tikker talibikit, Bagradas, aɛnaq n Giscon, lkamin n Scie, lexsas n Sardaigne akked wungal Salammbô n Flaubert.
heroAlt: Lkamin n yiɛeskriyen n uḍar akked ilfan n umenɣi, aquarelle n Rochegrosse
heroCap: Amenɣi n Macar (Bagradas), aquarelle n Georges Rochegrosse i tira n Salammbô, azal n 1900 (asinag n taẓwaṛt n Rouen).
title: Amennuɣ n Iɛeskriyen Uqeṛḍasen
epithet: Amenɣi « ur yettwasemmeḥ ara » — Qarṭaǧ mgal aɛesskar-is s yiman-is
lede: Mbeɛd aɣelli-ines zdat Ṛuma, Qarṭaǧ ur tezmir ara ad texles iɛeskriyen i yennuɣen fell-as di Sicile. Zzɛaf-nsen, imbeɛd ɛawant-t ifellaḥen ilibikiyen i yeḥṛesen s lxerj, yesserɣ Tafrikt tapunit ugar n krad iseggasen. Polybe yettwali deg-s amenɣi uqsiḥ akteṛ i yessen.
stats.0.t: n yiɛeskriyen uqeṛḍasen i d-yedduklen di Tunes deg tazwart n tikker
stats.1.t: n Ilibikiyen i dduklen akked yimexlafen s ssawal n Mathos
stats.2.t: n yixlafen ittwanɣan deg lkamin n Scie, seg azal n 50 000
stats.3.t: n umenɣi : « krad iseggasen d azal n kuẓ wagguren »
intro.title: Mi d-yezzi uɛesskar mgal temdint
intro.paras.0: Qarṭaǧ, tamdint n imsezzenzen idrusen, tenneɣ s iɛeskriyen i d-yekkan seg berra : Iberiyen, Iceltiyen, Iliguriyen, wid n Jzayer Baléares, Igrikiyen « yufraren » akked s telqey Ilibikiyen n tmurt-is s yiman-is. Deg 241, talwit n Lutatius tesmed amenɣi apunik amezwaru ; ilaq ad d-ttwarren yirgazen-agi seg Sicile, ad ttwaxelsen iseggasen n lexlaṣ.
intro.paras.1: Maca lxezna ilem : amenɣi yehdem tamdint, i yeṭṭfen daɣen 3200 n ttalan i Ṛuma. Asɣaṛ yuɣal d tikerrust, tikerrust tuɣal d amenɣi, amenɣi yuɣal d tikker n Tafrikt meṛṛa mgal taneddawt-is.
intro.paras.2: Polybe yessawel-as amenɣi « war asteɛfu » (ἄσπονδος), yettwasuɣlen s tefransist « ur yettwasemmeḥ ara » : ulac lemɛahda, ulac aḥnin i yettwaḥerzen dinna. Yessken-d Hamilkar Barka akked twacult-is, yesseɣli Qarṭaǧ Sardaigne.
sources.title: Taqsist qrib d tin kan
sources.items.0.d: Imezruyen, I, 65–88 : taqsist kan yemdewwiren s telqey, yettwaru lqern mbeɛd seg yiɣbula yeruḥen.
sources.items.1.d: Axxam n yidlisen n umezruy, adlis XXV : ucerreg, yesnernan ɣef tjeɣriyin.
sources.items.2.d: Libyca, 5 : asmekti awezɣan, s telqey ɣef tmsalt n Sardaigne.
sources.items.3.d: Tudert n Hamilkar, 2 : tikker d tanyafit n Hamilkar, deg kra n yisebtar.
sources.note: Imeskaren-agi akk uran seg tama n yimerbaḥ, iṛumaniyen neɣ igrikiyen. Ur nessin tikker ara ala s telqey sɣur-sen — akked yidrimen i ggen yixlafen s yiman-nsen.
causes.title: Ssababat
causes.aside: Lexlaṣ ur yettwaxelṣen ara, tuccḍa tasertant akked Tafrikt i yeεyan.
causes.items.0.d: Anezwi n Lilybée, Giscon yezzi yirgazen n Sicile s tirebbaɛ timeẓyanin, iwakken ad yizmir ad yexles ad yesserreḥ i yal yiwen d amgirdan. Maca Qarṭaǧ, ulac idrimen, teǧǧa-ten ttnernin deg temdint, imbeɛd tazen-ten meṛṛa ɣer Sicca s ifecka-nsen.
causes.items.1.d: Hanun — s telqey Hanun « Ameqqran », anezwi n tarbaɛt n yimaẓlaḥ imeqqranen — yettas ɣer Sicca ad yessuter i yiɛeskriyen ad qeblen asemẓi n lexlaṣ-nsen. Ulac win gar-asen i yettmeslayen yiwet n tutlayt ; aqerdac yegg-ed wayen-nniḍen. Ugar n 20 000 n yirgazen ṭṭfen abrid ɣer Tunes, qrib n Qarṭaǧ.
causes.items.2.d: Deg umenɣi mgal Ṛuma, Qarṭaǧ teṭṭef azgen n lmeḥṣul n ifellaḥen ilibikiyen tesnerna sin ikuḍan lxerj n timdinin. Mi Mathos yessawel-asen ɣer tikker, kkren-d akk ; tilawin, akken i d-yeqqar Polybe, fkant lǥawahar-nsent i uxleṣ n umenɣi.
people.title: Wid i yettekken
people.aside: Imenzaway n yixlafen i d-yekkan seg Lebḥer Ageraɣlan akk zdat yimenzaway iɛdawen n Qarṭaǧ.
people.rebelItems.0.d: Akli yerwel seg Iṛumaniyen, yuggad ad yettunefk i imɛellimen-is ma tedder talwit. Yesɛa awal, yesnerna lɛesker ɣer uqeṭṭeɛ. Yettwasellab zdat Tunes.
people.rebelItems.1.d: Argaz ilelli, yekcem deg uwexxer amezwaru. Yegg seg tkerrust amenɣi n tlelli talibikit, yuɣal d anezwi iɣezfen akteṛ n tikker. Yettwaṭṭef deg 237.
people.rebelItems.2.d: Anezwi n Iceltiyen, yemmeslay tapunikt, ayen i t-yegg yettwasellen sɣur meṛṛa. Netta, akked Spendios, i d-yefkan lǥuvu i tmettant n Giscon. Yettwaṭṭef deg Scie.
people.rebelItems.3.d: Anezwi n tarbaɛt talibikit, yedda akked Spendios d Autarite deg teklal taneggarut, yella gar wid i yeḥrez Hamilkar deg lkamin n Scie.
people.carthItems.0.d: Anezwi i yesnejman tuɣalin n yiɛeskriyen. Yettwazen ɣer Tunes s idrimen, yettwaṭṭef sɣur yixlafen akked yimdukkal-is, imbeɛd yettwaggerreẕ yettwanɣa.
people.carthItems.1.d: Yenɣelb zdat Utique s telqey n ugar n meyya n ilfan, imbeɛd yeǧǧa tacḍit-is ad tettwaṭṭef s lεjeb. Lemɣawla-ines akked Hamilkar tesnefses s telqey lqiyada.
people.carthItems.2.d: Ur yettwanɣi ara di Sicile, yettusawel s 10 000 n yirgazen akked 70 n ilfan. Anezwi n Bagradas akked Scie, yeffeɣ seg umenɣi d bab n lɛesker.
people.carthItems.3.d: Yeddu ɣer tacḍit n Hamilkar s 2000 n yineggafen ; s lemɛawna, Hamilkar yegalla-yas afus n yelli-s, i Polybe ur d-yefka ara isem-is.
chrono.title: Imeḥḍaren n umenɣi
chrono.rows.0.d: Talwit n Lutatius : Qarṭaǧ teffeɣ Sicile, teṭṭef 3200 n ttalan i Ṛuma. Giscon yezzi yiɛeskriyen ɣer Tafrikt.
chrono.rows.1.d: Hanun yessuter asemẓi n lexlaṣ ; ugar n 20 000 n yiɛeskriyen ṭṭfen abrid ɣer Tunes. Qarṭaǧ tenekkar meṛṛa, aṭas lweqt.
chrono.rows.2.d: Spendios d Mathos sekkṛen lɛesker ; Giscon d yimdukkal-is ttwaṭṭfen. Azal n 70 000 n Ilibikiyen dduklen ɣer tikker.
chrono.rows.3.t: Aḥeṛṣ n Utique d Hippou Acra
chrono.rows.3.d: Ixlafen ḥeṛṣen snat timdinin imdukkal n Qarṭaǧ, sekkṛen tamdint seg Tunes. Hanun yesellek Utique imbeɛd yettuṭṭef s lεjeb.
chrono.rows.4.d: Hamilkar yezger asif ɣer tama-ines, s wemkan i d-ibeggen waḏu, yenyaf Spendios : 6000 n yixlafen ttwanɣan, 2000 n yimeḥbas (Polybe, I, 76).
chrono.rows.5.d: Anumidi yeddu akked Hamilkar ; tanyafit tamaynut : 10 000 ttwanɣan, 4000 n yimeḥbas, i Hamilkar yefka afus-is ad kecmen deg lɛesker-is neɣ ad ṛuḥen ilelli.
chrono.rows.6.d: Iwakken ur ițeffeg ara wiyaḍ, imenzaway n yixlafen ggren Giscon akked azal n 700 n yimeḥbas ttwaggerreẕen ttwanɣan. Hamilkar yettarra s ma yeg aɣilaf n yimeḥbas ddaw n yiḍaren n ilfan.
chrono.rows.7.d: Snat timdinin-agi nɣant tacḍit-nsent, sersent iman-nsent zdat Ṛuma, i tt-yugin. Qarṭaǧ s yiman-is tettwaḥeṛṣ sɣur Mathos d Spendios.
chrono.rows.8.d: Hamilkar yesserɣel lɛesker n Spendios deg « Prion ». Laẓ yewweḍ, ixlafen azenen-d imeqdimen-nsen, i Hamilkar yeḥrez ; ugar n 40 000 n yirgazen ttwanɣan.
chrono.rows.9.d: Spendios akked yimeqdimen ttwasellaben ddaw n lesswar. Mathos yettaṭṭef tacḍit n unezwi wis sin, Hanibal, yessellab-it netta daɣen.
chrono.rows.10.d: Hanun akked Hamilkar, msefhamen sɣur Ssenaṭ, ḥeznen Mathos qrib Leptis. Yettwazzi deg Qarṭaǧ, yettwaɛneq sɣur lɣaci. Utique d Hippou Acra fkant iman-nsent.
chrono.rows.11.d: Ṛuma tṭṭef tigzirt tessuter 1200 n ttalan-nniḍen s tḥadart n umenɣi. Hamilkar yeddu drus mbeɛd ɣer Hispanya.
chrono.note: Polybe ur d-yefka ara iseggasen : tasuddemt tettwabna. Tugget n yimesnezruyen srsen amenɣi seg tagara n 241 armi d tazwart n 237 ; kra smenyafen 240–238, izemzan ițwaseqdacen deg umkan-nniḍen deg usmel-agi.
map.title: Amḍiq n yimenɣan
map.aside: Amenɣi meṛṛa iteddu di tama n Qarṭaǧ, ger wasif n Medjerda akked Sahel.
map.aria: Takarṭa tasnulfant n ugafa-agmur n Tunisia : Qarṭaǧ, Tunes, Utique, Hippou Acra, Sicca, Leptis akked wasif n Bagradas
map.legX: Tamddakelt n Qarṭaǧ, teɛdda ɣer yixlafen
map.rows.0.v: Le Kef. Qarṭaǧ tezzi dinna iɛeskriyen uqeṛḍasen ; dinna i tebda tikker.
map.rows.1.v: Axxam n unemhal n yixlafen deg umenɣi meṛṛa, yettwali ɣer Qarṭaǧ.
map.rows.2.v: Tamdint tafiniqit taqdimt akteṛ di Tafrikt, tella ɣer rrif n lebḥer. Tettwaḥeṛṣ, imbeɛd teɛda ɣer yixlafen.
map.rows.3.v: Bizerte. Lqerra-s am win n Utique.
map.rows.4.v: Medjerda, yettwassemma daɣen Macar. Hamilkar yezger-it qrib n tama-ines.
map.rows.5.v: Amḍiq n umenɣi aneggaru, ahat Leptis Minor (Lamta), ɣef rrif n Sahel.
map.note: Rrif n wassa : ifecka n wasif n Medjerda ɛemmṛen agaraw n Utique. Amḍiq n lkamin n Scie ur yettwassen ara ; ur yettwaskan ara ɣef tkarṭa.
cruel.title: Tjeɣrit tettnerni
cruel.intro: Seg snat tama, tjeɣrit tuɣal d allal n tsertit : imenzaway n yixlafen bɣan ad sgellun lemɛahda meṛṛa, Qarṭaǧ tebɣa ad teg lemtel.
cruel.quote: « Ur nessin ula d yiwen umenɣi i d-yuɣalen akteṛ n wa deg tjeɣrit akked tnekra n leqwanin. »
cruel.cite: Akken i d-yeqqar Polybe, Imezruyen, I, 88
cruel.steps.0.d: Uggaden aḥnin n Hamilkar, Spendios, Autarite d Mathos gezmen ifassen n Giscon akked azal n 700 n yimeḥbas, ggerrẕen-ten, ṛẕen iḍaṛṛen-nsen grent-ten d iddren deg wezger. Srsen ad yeg yal ameḥbus aqarṭaǧi lqerra-nni.
cruel.steps.1.d: Hamilkar yeǧǧa aḥnin : imeḥbas ttunefken ɣer ilfan. Ixlafen ugin ula ad rren igerman i Yiqarṭaǧiyen i d-yusan ad sutren-ten.
cruel.steps.2.d: Spendios yettwasellab zdat lesswar n Tunes. Mathos yettarra mi yeṭṭef anezwi Hanibal — war azday akked mmi-s n Hamilkar —, yesnejla-t ɣef wezger n Spendios, yegzem tlatin n imeqqranen iqarṭaǧiyen ɣer tama-s.
cruel.steps.3.d: Yettwaṭṭef qrib Leptis, Mathos yettwazzi deg Qarṭaǧ deg teklal n triyunf, yettwaɛneq s wudem n lmut sɣur imeẓyanen n temdint. Kra n tikwal qqaren-d yettwasellab : Polybe yeqqar-d ɣef aɛnaq azayez, mačči ɣef wezger.
saw.title: Lkamin n Scie
saw.paras.0: Deg 238, Spendios, Autarite akked Zarzas ṭṭfen tiẓgi s azal n 50 000 n yirgazen. Hamilkar yegri amenɣi usrid : yeḥreṣ aɛdaw, yegzem-as lqut, yesseg deg umḍiq i yesεan talɣa n tsekkurt yessemma Prion, « Scie ».
saw.paras.1: Izzin fell-asen, war lqut ne lemɛawna n Tunes, ixlafen ttțen imeḥbas-nsen, imbeɛd aklan-nsen. Imenzaway qeblen asefham : Hamilkar yessuter ad yefren mraw n yirgazen s lebɣi-s, wiyaḍ ad ṛuḥen s tqendurt. Mbeɛd lemɛahda, yeqqar-d yefren… mraw n imeqdimen i d-iεeddan.
saw.paras.2: War imenzaway-nsen, ɣilen lemɛahda tḥerreb, lɛesker yeṭṭef leslaḥ. Hamilkar yezzi-t s ilfan-is akked lɛesker-is : ugar n 40 000 n yirgazen mmuten. D tagara n umenɣi, ɣas akken Mathos mazal-it yeṭṭef Tunes.
saw.boxD: Tacḍit-agi, ma d lexdeɛ i telli ? Polybe yesken-d afran n mraw-nni d win ițeddun ɣef wawal n lemɛahda. Imesnezruyen imaynuten ttwalin deg-s aṭas n tikwal tamuɣli tuqsiḥt, i d-yesekknen amenɣi anida ulac ula d yiwet n lqanun yeqqimen.
rome.title: Imezdaɣen-nniḍen ḥesben tiwtilin
rome.paras.0: Deg tazwart, Ṛuma tesken-d lḥala yelhan : tegdel i yimsezzenzen-is ad zzuzzen i yixlafen, teǧǧa Qarṭaǧ ad teẓẓa di Italya, tserreḥ war ssuma i yimeḥbas-ines n umenɣi tenekkar ssuter n Utique ad teg iman-is d tamellalt-is. Hiéron n Syracuse, netta, yazen-d lqut : ur yebɣi ara Ṛuma war umgirdan (Polybe, I, 83 ; Appien, Sicelica, 2).
rome.paras.1: Maca iɛeskriyen uqeṛḍasen n Sardaigne kkren-d netta daɣen, nɣan anezwi-nsen Bostar, sḍefṛen Iqarṭaǧiyen, uqbel ad ttwasḍefṛen s yiman-nsen sɣur Isardiyen. Yezdeɣ di Italya, ssawalen Ṛuma.
rome.paras.2: Deg 238/237, mi Qarṭaǧ tebɣa ad tuɣal ɣer tegzirt, Ṛuma teqqar-d belli aheggi-agi ɣur-s yettwasers, teg lameṛ n umenɣi. Teεya, Qarṭaǧ teǧǧa Sardaigne tessexleṣ 1200 n ttalan-nniḍen. Polybe, ɣas akken yesɛa laman di Ṛuma, yeqqar-d lecɣal-agi war ṣṣwab (III, 28).
rome.cap: Tiɣilt n Byrsa : Qarṭaǧ, tettwaḥeṛṣ sɣur lɛesker-is s yiman-is, teqqel ɣef lebḥer-is d yimdukkal-is.
conseq.title: Tanyafit i yesnejman amenɣi i d-iteddun
conseq.items.0.d: Ttalan ssutren ugar n lexlaṣ n 241, akked tuǧǧa n Sardaigne, imbeɛd n Corse. Polybe yettwali deg-s yiwet seg ssababat n umenɣi apunik wis sin (III, 10).
conseq.items.1.d: Hamilkar yewweḍ ɣer Gadès akked mmi-s Hanibal. Teḥuddu seg tegzirin-is, Qarṭaǧ tettnadi di Hispanya ɣef nnuqra d yiɛeskriyen i yexṣen.
conseq.items.2.d: Yettwafren sɣur lɛesker mgal Hanun, Hamilkar yeffeɣ seg umenɣi s lɛesker iḥemmlen-t akked lɛawna n ugdud. Amennuɣ ger sin yirgazen-agi yuɣal d ul n tudert tasertant.
conseq.items.3.d: Timdinin tilibikiyin ɛeddant ɣer taɣwalt. Qarṭaǧ tkemmel asɣaṛ n yiɛeskriyen uqeṛḍasen, maca lɛesker n At Barka ad qqnen ɣer unezwi-nsen.
sal.title: Salammbô, ungal n umenɣi
sal.aside: Deg 1862, Flaubert yegg amennuɣ n Iɛeskriyen Uqeṛḍasen d amḍiq n wungal i yesresen azal n lqern tugna n Qarṭaǧ.
sal.alt: Salammbô s uqendur azegzaw d ddheb, aquarelle n Rochegrosse
sal.cap: Salammbô, aquarelle n Georges Rochegrosse i tira yettwaɣzan n 1900.
sal.subtitle: Ungal yeḍfeṛ Polybe s telqey… siwa taneḍmant
sal.paras.0: Mbeɛd Madame Bovary, Flaubert yebɣa ad yerr Qarṭaǧ ddren. Yeɣra Polybe akked tnac n yimusnawen, imbeɛd izur Tunes akked umḍiq n Qarṭaǧ deg tafsut n 1858. Salammbô yeḍheṛ-d deg 1862 : tiqsiṭ teḍfeṛ s telqey tasuddemt n Polybe, seg timεict n yiɛeskriyen armi d aɛnaq n Mâtho.
sal.paras.1: Deg ul n tiqsiṭ, yesres taneḍmant n usnulfu-ines : Salammbô, yelli-s n Hamilkar d takahint n Tanit, i Mâtho, anezwi n yixlafen, yettḥemmel s telqey. Flaubert yebna ɣef tɣawsa n tidet : Polybe yeqqar-d belli Hamilkar yegalla yelli-s i ugellid anumidi Naravas — war ma yefka-d isem-is.
sal.trueT: Ayen i yeṭṭef Flaubert seg Polybe

sal.trueItems.1: Hamilkar, Hanun, Giscon, Spendius, Mâtho, Autharite, Narr'Havas
sal.trueItems.2: Amenɣi n Macar akked webrid i d-yesekcem waḏu
sal.trueItems.4: Lkamin n Scie, yettwasemma daɣen « lkamin n tsula », akked laẓ
sal.trueItems.5: Lǥuvu n yelli-s n Hamilkar i Naravas
sal.trueItems.6: Aɛnaq n Mâtho, yettwazzi deg Qarṭaǧ

sal.falseItems.1: Tuker n zaïmph, aɣummu iqeddsen n Tanit
sal.falseItems.2: Azrem iqeddsen akked leɛwayed n takahint
sal.falseItems.3: Lebraṣ n Hanun akked timεict deg yiferkiwen n Hamilkar
sal.falseItems.4: Asfel ameqqran n warraw i Moloch deg uḥeṛṣ, yekka-d seg tadyant n 310 i d-yeḥka Diodore (XX, 14) — tɣawsa mazal-itt tettwasmeyya
sal.falseItems.5: Asbeddel n Hanibal amecṭuḥ s mmi-s n wakli
sal.after.0.v: Amesnemyazal Sainte-Beuve akked umesnefrar Guillaume Froehner smiden ṣṣeḥḥa n wungal ; Flaubert yerra-yasen awal s awal, s yiɣbula.
sal.after.1.v: Moussorgski yettwaxdem lopera Salammbô, yeǧǧa-t war tifukt.
sal.after.2.v: Lopera n Ernest Reyer, yettwaxdem di Bruxelles ; ḍfeṛen-t lǥafitat, ibellaεen d ifilmen i yesnernan tugna n Qarṭaǧ taɛezrit tuqsiḥt.
sal.after.3.v: Agraw n Salammbô, di Qarṭaǧ, anida llant lebḥura ipuniyen akked tofet, yesεa isem-is seg wungal — akked yid-s amur n tugna n Ccerq n temdint.
more.title: Ɣer daɣen
more.items.0.d: Win ur yettwanɣi ara di Sicile, anyaf n Scie d unettaɛ n Hispanya.
more.items.1.d: Ilibikiyen, imdukkal inumidiyen d yiɛeskriyen uqeṛḍasen : anagraw yelhan, d uẓawan-is.
more.items.2.d: Ssenaṭ, sufeṭ d tejmaɛt ; Hanun Ameqqran zdat At Barka.
